redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses a distinct material fact or strategic theme: D1 (financial performance), D2 (external challenges), D3 (market diversification), D4 (cost base optimization), D5 (product innovation), D6 (liquidity management), D7 (geographical shift), D8 (defense project). No unit is a subset or duplicate of another.

key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance for 2025 versus 2024: order intake increased 37% to SEK 142M (from SEK 103M), net sales grew 11% to SEK 131M (from SEK 118M), operating profit improved to SEK -1.9M (from SEK -9.7M), profit after tax was SEK -2.5M (from SEK -7.7M), cash flow was SEK +3.7M (from SEK +6.8M), and no dividend was proposed.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report (page 19) and condensed income statement (page 19) show year-on-year comparisons for order intake, net sales, operating profit, profit after tax, and cash flow. Dividend proposal stated in Management report (page 21) and Share section (page 18).

key_information_units.information: Operational impact of external challenges: geopolitical uncertainty suppressed demand in the largest segment (warehousing and logistics), a ~20% depreciation of the US dollar against the Swedish krona (affecting 74% of sales and gross margin), and customs duties on non-European components increased administrative costs and burden.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO letter (page 5-6) explicitly details geopolitical uncertainty, weak demand in logistics, currency effects (USD lost almost 20% against SEK), and customs duty impacts on inventory valuation and administrative workload.

key_information_units.information: Strategic diversification into ports, construction, and mining equipment segments to reduce reliance on the weakened logistics market, with early results reported from increased focus in these areas.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO letter (page 5) states: 'We are addressing this weakness by increasing focus in other segments, especially ports as well as construction and mining equipment – areas where we are now starting to see results.' Investor highlights (page 7) reinforce diversified market mix as a value driver.

key_information_units.information: Cost base reduction through structural changes: discontinuation of subsidiary JLT Software Solutions AB, coordination of software development, and write-downs of capitalized development costs led to SEK 5M lower overhead and improved operational leverage.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO letter (page 5) describes cost-saving measures, including overhead reduction of SEK 5M from structural changes and discontinued subsidiary operations. Note 5 (page 34) confirms personnel cost decreases reflect these initiatives.

key_information_units.information: Launch of material product innovations: industry's first rugged on-board computer with a 15-inch Full HD display (JLT6015) and an AI-powered 'screen blanking' safety solution validated for port operations, strengthening premium positioning in prioritized segments.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO letter (page 6) announces JLT6015 launch and AI screen blanking solution. Product development section (page 20) confirms validation by Navis for port operations and presentations at trade fairs in Rotterdam and Singapore.

key_information_units.information: Liquidity management success: inventory reduced by SEK 12.7M to SEK 25.5M, improving cash flow and capital efficiency, with cash and cash equivalents increasing to SEK 16.9M (from SEK 13.3M).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report (page 20) states inventory reduction of MSEK 12.7 during the year. Cash flow statement (page 30) shows operating cash flow of SEK +3.7M and balance sheet (page 27) reports cash and cash equivalents of SEK 16.9M at year-end.

key_information_units.information: Geographical sales shift: Americas region contributed 70.1% of 2025 sales (SEK 92.2M, up from 59.0% in 2024), while Nordics contribution fell to 11.1% (SEK 14.5M, down from 15.4%), reflecting regional strength and segment-specific challenges.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 2 (page 33) provides sales breakdown by region for 2025 and 2024, showing Americas at 92.2M (70.1%) vs 69.8M (59.0%) and Nordics at 14.5M (11.1%) vs 18.2M (15.4%).

key_information_units.information: Initiation of a strategic project to evaluate defense market opportunities in the second half of 2025, with associated costs of approximately SEK 1 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report comments on operations (page 20) state: 'During the second half of the year, a project was initiated to evaluate the possibilities of addressing the defense market. The total costs for this during the year amounted to approximately SEK 1 million.'
